ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left side of the figure is a three-membered oxirane/ethylene oxide structure, with one O atom in the ring; the left ring carbon is connected to R1, and the right ring carbon is connected to the substituted carbon on the right; wedge bonds are also drawn in the figure to indicate the stereochemical relationship of the two ring carbons. The substituted carbon on the right is connected to R2, OH, and NH-NH2, and there is also a positively charged H+ in the figure; the curved arrows only indicate electron/proton transfer, and the problem asks to ignore them. Then reasoning: Represent both R1 and R2 with wildcard atoms *. According to the specified traversal, write the oxirane as *[C@H]1O[C@@H]1, and use opposite chiral labels to represent the wedge stereochemical relationship of the two ring carbons in the figure. The right ring carbon is then connected to the substituted carbon C(*)(O)NN, where * corresponds to R2, O corresponds to OH, and NN corresponds to NH-NH2. Finally write the separately shown proton as a disconnected ionic component .[H+]. Therefore the SMILES is *[C@H]1O[C@@H]1C(*)(O)NN.[H+].

method.method_draft: First identify only the actual atoms and bonds in the drawing, ignoring all curved arrows as requested. Convert R1 and R2 substituents to wildcard atoms. Write the oxirane ring as *[C@H]1O[C@@H]1, using the shown wedge stereochemistry to set opposite chiral tags for the two ring carbons in the selected traversal order. Attach the right ring carbon to the substituted carbon C(*)(O)NN corresponding to R2, OH, and NH–NH2. Finally append the separately shown proton as a disconnected ionic component, giving *[C@H]1O[C@@H]1C(*)(O)NN.[H+].
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中左侧是一个三元氧杂环/环氧乙烷结构，环中有一个 O 原子，左侧环碳连接 R1，右侧环碳连接到右边的取代碳；图中还画有楔形键来表示两个环碳的立体关系。右侧取代碳连接 R2、OH、NH-NH2，并且图中另有一个带正电的 H+；弯曲箭头只表示电子/质子转移，题目要求忽略。再推理：将 R1 和 R2 都用通配原子 * 表示。按指定遍历把环氧乙烷写为 *[C@H]1O[C@@H]1，并用相反的手性标记表示图中两个环碳的楔形立体关系。右侧环碳再连接到取代碳 C(*)(O)NN，其中 * 对应 R2，O 对应 OH，NN 对应 NH-NH2。最后把单独显示的质子作为断开的离子组分写成 .[H+]。因此 SMILES 为 *[C@H]1O[C@@H]1C(*)(O)NN.[H+]。

planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the task is to choose the SMILES for the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored; no other textual chemical facts are needed.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent unspecified R groups as wildcard atoms '*'; encode the epoxide as a three-membered ring with ring index 1; convert OH to O and NH–NH2 to NN; encode the free proton as a disconnected component '.[H+]'; assign tetrahedral chirality tags @/@@ according to the wedge/dash stereochemistry and the chosen atom ordering.
